notes.notes:

2. A turret’s broken state has been removed. Turrets will instead be completely destroyed by enemies when sufficiently damaged.
3. The method in which the enemy appears has been redesigned.
4. Scenes have been optimized.
5. Many small bug fixes.

notes.title: New Update 1.10
notes.notes:
1. The camera has been set to lock on to Ada. [A] [D] are used to fine-tune the perspective.
2. Switching between Ada and Zoe’s perspective has been removed. You can now place turrets at all times.
3. The energy stone’s energy limit has been removed.
4. Placed turrets will now consume Zoe’s energy. Zoe’s energy will recharge slowly.
5. The interface has been redesigned.

1. 摄像机视角已经被设置成锁定Ada。[A][D]用于部分地图的微调视角。
2. 取消 Ada与Zoe的切换，现在可以随时放置炮塔。
3. 取消 能量石的能量限制。
4. 放置炮塔将消耗Zoe能量，Zoe能量会慢慢恢复。
5. 游戏界面进行了重新设计。
